subject: Critical: Streaming pauses and chunk drops under burst load — leadership attention
messages:
From: Allison Park <apark@stitchdata.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent streaming pauses causing client timeouts during bulk inference

Hi Stephanie,

We're seeing repeated WebSocket read timeouts and partial responses when running our nightly bulk inference job against the dedicated pool you provisioned for us. The client reports a 30s read timeout and the stream occasionally resumes with missing chunks (partial responses). This started around 02:15 UTC and has happened on three separate runs since then.

Symptoms:
- WebSocket read timeout (client-side): "read: timeout after 30s"
- Server responses resume but one or more token chunks are missing (client shows truncation markers)
- Error rate spikes correlate with throughput peaks (~1.6x above baseline)

I've attached a short log snapshot (stitch_streaming_error_snapshot_20270410.log) and a brief screen capture of the client timeouts. We can reproduce reliably in our staging environment when we scale to 12 concurrent streams.

This is impacting our scheduled data pipeline and downstream dashboards. Please advise ASAP — we can jump on a call if helpful.

Thanks,
Allison Park
Head of Platform | StitchData
Attachments: stitch_streaming_error_snapshot_20270410.log (text), screen_capture_0410.mp4 (video stub)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Allison Park <apark@stitchdata.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:18:24 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent streaming pauses causing client timeouts during bulk inference

Allison — thanks for the report and the logs. We're on it.

Rishi/Priyom: I need immediate triage and an interim mitigation for StitchData. Customer is seeing client-side 30s timeouts and partial chunks; this is impacting their nightly runs. Please coordinate with Ops and propose a short remediation plan within 30 minutes. If this cannot be contained in <=2 hours, escalate to leadership and we may need to offer credits/exec commit.

Marissa — FYI and please be ready to mirror the customer comms (they're on a paid Dedicated contract).

I'll stand by for updates; Allison, apologies for the disruption — we'll prioritize.

-steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0142
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Allison Park <apark@stitchdata.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:42:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent streaming pauses causing client timeouts during bulk inference

Stephanie / team,

Quick triage notes (initial):
- Reproduced failure pattern in staging when simulating 12 concurrent streams with payload sizes ~2.5-3.5k tokens.
- Kernel traces show intermittent stall at the chunk-emit stage (chunked-transfer layer). There are GC spikes on the host process at the same timestamps — looks like periodic memory compaction on the dedicated pool that pauses token emission for ~20-35s.
- Affected pool: dedicated-us-central-3 (customer-dedicated-57).

Interim mitigation options:
1) Route StitchData to adjacent pool with same model but a different kernel selection (dedicated-us-central-5) — low-risk, immediate, estimated cutover ~15min.
2) Temporarily reduce batch size to avoid GC spikes; may increase per-request latency.
3) Hotfix: adjust memory alloc flags and recompile the chunking shader — needs dev + ops, ETA 8-12 hours to deploy safely.

Attached: redwood-debug-log-20270410.tar.gz (contains kernel traces and GC timestamps).

Recommendation: execute option (1) now to stop timeouts, then follow with (3) as a permanent fix. I'll prepare the JIRA (INF-2321) and a test plan.

-Priyom
Priyom Das
SRE Lead, Inference Platform | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-debug-log-20270410.tar.gz (archive)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Allison Park <apark@stitchdata.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 10:05:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent streaming pauses causing client timeouts during bulk inference

Thanks Priyom — I dug into the kernel traces and agree with the GC correlation. Additional notes:
- The dedicated-us-central-3 pool metadata shows a recent autoscaler bump (extra workers spun up) which may have triggered the allocator heuristics we adjusted last month.
- Fast rollback path: change routing rule for StitchData's route key to dedicated-us-central-5 and pin model variant to previous kernel (v1.9.2) for 1 hour canary.
- Ops checklist for cutover (I can own): create canary route, monitor token emission latency, switch back if errors increase. Expected customer-visible interruption: <2 minutes during DNS/route propagation.

I'll start the canary immediately after we get Allison sign-off. Priyom, please confirm the hotfix JIRA and test plan.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

Hannah / Marissa — forwarding incident summary and logs. StitchData is experiencing streaming pauses that manifest as client-side 30s read timeouts and occasional missing chunks during high-throughput windows. Rishi/Priyom have a mitigation plan to route to an adjacent pool immediately and push a hotfix tonight.

Impact: nightly bulk job failures for one paid Dedicated customer; customers' dashboards update delayed and SLA at risk.

Ask: please be prepared to approve a goodwill credit if we cannot reach a permanent resolution within 24 hours. I'll keep you posted with the canary results.

-steph
From: Allison Park <apark@stitchdata.com>

Thanks — routing to the alternate pool fixed the 30s timeouts for the last two runs. We're still observing slightly higher end-to-end latency (~10-15% increase) but no dropped chunks so far. Please confirm ETA for the permanent fix and whether you can share the postmortem once the JIRA is created.

Also: can we get a short note for our ops team describing the root cause so we can annotate our pipeline?

Allison
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Allison Park <apark@stitchdata.com>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent streaming pauses causing client timeouts during bulk inference — resolution plan

Update: hotfix JIRA created (INF-2321) and patch landed in canary branch. Test plan (rfc-chunking-test-plan.pdf) attached to the ticket.

Deployment plan:
- Tonight 02:00 UTC: rollout to 10% of traffic; monitor GC/emit latency for 2 hours.
- 4 hours later: if green, step to 50%; then to 100% after another 6 hours pending green checks.

Customer comms: we will share a short root-cause note after the full rollout. For now: cause = allocator/GC interaction with chunked-transfer kernel under certain batch/sequence size distributions; mitigation = route then hotfix to adjust allocator flags and kernel memory handling.

I've attached the test plan and the merged patch summary. If anything changes I'll update this thread.

-Priyom
SRE Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachments: rfc-chunking-test-plan.pdf
